description: Valid and invalid 2.2 sources outside the gate-1 corpus whose diagnostics spell a quoted contextual word (view, state, in, out): association and test-access hints of SW2010, ambiguity messages of SW2001 with their related information, and other messages naming such names (WP2 review H1). Each parses with the kept 2.2 grammar. Their diagnostics (with related information), normalized ASTs and runs are recorded once from implementation 3.1.0 in recorded-wp2b.json and compared by scripts/compatibility-2-2-extended.mjs.
